spoken_first_2s: अस्सलाम वालेकुम इस वीडियो के अंदर दो चीज

notes.hook: 'Assalam walekum, is video ke andar do cheez share karunga, gaur se dekhna'
notes.what_goes_wrong: Greeting plus an agenda fills the first 5 seconds, then jargon about piston rings with no visible cost of getting it wrong.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: greeting + 'is video mein do cheezein' openers; lead with the costly symptom (engine smoke, a ₹ repair bill).
